title: What percentage of KAM customers pay in euros?
question: What percentage of KAM customers pay in euros?

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(T1.CustomerID) AS percentage
FROM CustomerCurrency AS T1
INNER JOIN CustomerInfo AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T2.Segment = 'KAM'
